doxmind.label: doXmind
points: Agent-level AI built into every layer of the editor

From rough draft to polished presentation in one tool

advantages.heading: What makes doXmind different
advantages.subtitle: Capabilities you won't find in Notion or Google Docs.

thinkingAI.title: AI that thinks with you
thinkingAI.description: doXmind's AI shows its reasoning step-by-step. Review every AI edit as an inline diff — accept or reject changes with a single click. Chat about your document with an agent-level AI that truly understands context.

knowledgePowered.title: Your knowledge, AI-powered
knowledgePowered.description: Upload research papers, style guides, and reference documents. The KB Agent searches across all your materials, synthesizes answers, and cites sources with relevance scores. Your AI is grounded in your knowledge.

dataToPresentation.title: From data to presentation
dataToPresentation.description: Drop a CSV and get instant AI-powered visualizations. Write your analysis in the same document. Then present it full-screen — no switching between apps. One seamless workflow from raw data to polished slides.
